parameters.help_en: The ID of the CEN instance
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the Enterprise Edition transit router is deployed.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
企业版转发路由器实例所属地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC connection
parameters.name: transit_router_attachment_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Enterprise Edition transit router
parameters.help_zh: 企业版转发路由器实例ID
parameters.name: transit_router_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. The default value is 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。默认值为20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results.

If this is your first query or no more results are available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

For subsequent queries, set this parameter to the `NextToken` value from the previous response
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

fields.help_en:
The tag key.

The tag key must be 1 to 64 characters in length, and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。

一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`或者`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https:// `。

一次最多支持输入20个标签的标签键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value.

The tag value can be 0 to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。

标签值可以为空或输入不超过128个字符的字符串，不能以`aliyun`或者`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https:// `。

每一个标签键对应一个标签值，一次最多支持输入20个标签键对应的标签值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The tags.

You can specify up to 20 tags
parameters.help_zh:
标签信息。

一次最多支持输入20个标签信息
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
The entity that pays for the network instance. Valid values:

PayByCenOwner: The fees are paid by the account that owns the CEN instance.

PayByResourceOwner: The fees are paid by the account that owns the network instance
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例的付费方。取值：

PayByCenOwner：表示网络实例产生的费用由云企业网实例所属的账号承担。
PayByResourceOwner：表示网络实例产生的费用由网络实例所属的账号承担
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en:
The status of the VPC connection. Valid values:

Attaching: The VPC connection is being created.

Attached: The VPC connection is created.

Detaching: The VPC connection is being deleted
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例的加载状态。

Attaching：加载中。
Attached：已加载。
Detaching：卸载中
parameters.name: status

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries to return on each page
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数

NextToken.description_en:
The token to retrieve the next page of results.

If this parameter is empty, all results have been returned.

If a value is returned for NextToken, it is the token to start the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

AutoPublishRouteEnabled.description_en:
Specifies whether the Enterprise Edition transit router automatically advertises routes to the VPC.

false: Routes are not automatically advertised.

true: Routes are automatically advertised
AutoPublishRouteEnabled.description_zh:
企业版转发路由器是否自动发布路由到VPC实例。

false：否。
true：是

CenId.description_en: The ID of the CEN instance

ChargeType.description_en:
The billing method of the VPC connection.

The value is always POSTPAY, which indicates the pay-as-you-go billing method
ChargeType.description_zh:
VPC连接的付费类型。

仅取值：POSTPAY，表示按使用量后付费

CreationTime.description_en:
The time when the VPC connection was created.

The time is in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ` format and in UTC
CreationTime.description_zh:
VPC连接的创建时间。

时间按照ISO8601标准表示，并使用UTC时间。格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ

ManagedService.description_en: The cloud service to which the resource belongs

ApplianceModeSupport.description_en:
Specifies whether appliance mode is enabled.

disable (default): Appliance mode is disabled.

enable: Appliance mode is enabled
ApplianceModeSupport.description_zh:
是否开启网元导流模式。

disable（默认值）：否。
enable：是

Ipv6Support.description_en:
Specifies whether IPv6 is enabled.

disable (default): IPv6 is disabled.

enable: IPv6 is enabled
Ipv6Support.description_zh:
是否支持IPv6。

disable（默认值）：否。
enable：是

OrderType.description_en:
Specifies who pays for the network instance. Valid values:

PayByCenOwner: The account that owns the CEN instance pays the fees.

PayByResourceOwner: The account that owns the network instance pays the fees
OrderType.description_zh:
网络实例的付费方。取值：

PayByCenOwner：表示网络实例产生的费用由云企业网实例所属的账号承担。
PayByResourceOwner：表示网络实例产生的费用由网络实例所属的账号承担

ResourceType.description_en:
The type of resource to which the connection is attached.

The value is always VPC, which indicates a VPC
ResourceType.description_zh:
连接所属的资源类型。

仅取值：VPC，表示专有网络实例

Status.description_en:
The status of the VPC connection.

Attached: The connection is established.

Attaching: The connection is being created.

Detaching: The connection is being deleted
Status.description_zh:
VPC连接的状态。

Attached：已加载。
Attaching：加载中。
Detaching：卸载中

TransitRouterAttachmentDescription.description_en: The description of the VPC connection

TransitRouterAttachmentId.description_en: The ID of the VPC connection

TransitRouterAttachmentName.description_en: The name of the VPC connection

TransitRouterId.description_en: The ID of the Enterprise Edition transit router
TransitRouterId.description_zh: 企业版转发路由器实例ID

additionalProperties.description_en:
ipv6Support: Indicates whether IPv6 is enabled. This setting defaults to the current IPv6 status of the VPC connection.

enable: IPv6 is enabled.

disable: IPv6 is disabled
additionalProperties.description_zh:
VPC连接的功能属性（即将废弃，请使用新入参 Options）。

ipv6Support：是否已开启IPv6功能。默认值为当前VPC连接IPv6功能开启的状态。
   
enable：已开启IPv6功能。
disable：未开启IPv6功能

TransitRouterVPCAttachmentOptions.description_en: The feature attributes of the VPC connection. This parameter is deprecated. We recommend that you use the Options parameter instead
TransitRouterVPCAttachmentOptions.description_zh: VPC连接的功能属性列表（即将废弃，请使用新入参 Options）

VpcOwnerId.description_en: The ID of the account that owns the VPC

VpcRegionId.description_en: The ID of the region where the VPC is deployed

ZoneMappings.description_en: The zone mappings of the VPC connection. This includes the vSwitches and elastic network interfaces (ENIs) in the associated VPC
ZoneMappings.description_zh: VPC连接的可用区信息及其关联的VPC实例的交换机和弹性网卡的信息

NetworkInterfaceId.description_en: The ID of the ENI that the Enterprise Edition transit router creates in the vSwitch
NetworkInterfaceId.description_zh: 企业版转发路由器在交换机中创建的弹性网卡的ID
